verdict.rationale: Hightouch ships built-in AI agents, so letting users connect external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence documents only Hightouch's own MCP server, which exposes Hightouch tools to outside AI assistants. That is the server role. Nothing shows Hightouch's agent acting as an MCP client that consumes tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
